concept_title: 03 Stack — single-surface progressive disclosure (expand-in-place + push/pop FLIP depth)
design_contract_summary: Settings Home is ONE vertical stack of expandable destination rows; search is the HEAD of the stack; selecting a row expands it IN PLACE (push/pop FLIP depth) rather than navigating away; notices sit at the head; each expanded destination hosts its subcategory subnav + setting rows + inline manager surfaces; the four C3 kinds (Skills/Plugins/Tools/Commands) are demonstrated distinctly inside the shared Skills manager plus a dedicated Commands & Shortcuts manager; core (Home/Search/Workspace/Provider/installations/ordinary row grammar) is demonstrated; sibling families are reachable via shared row grammar.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Settings workspace is a single expandable stack, not a category modal/bloom; selecting a destination expands it in place with push/pop FLIP depth and a sticky in-row subnav.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Destination rows (.st-item) expand to reveal body with subcategory pills (.st-subnav sticky) + setting sections + inline manager; only one destination expands its full manager at a time; collapse-all returns to stack top.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: File Manager/Editor demonstrates tree (virtualized/lazy), workspace-only drag/drop with FileSafe enforcement, hidden/ignored (.gitignore + globs), large-file threshold hex preview, tabs/split groups, changed-on-disk (reload/keep/compare), recovery + transient/unavailable reasons.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Inline file-manager surface inside the expanded 'Code & Execution' destination: virtualized tree, drag/drop constrained to workspace roots, .gitignore-aware ignore rows, large-file row flips to hex preview above code.editing.large-file-threshold, changed-on-disk badge offers reload/keep/compare, transient/unavailable shown via AvailabilityReason.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: LSP manager: registry/catalog/provenance, startup mode, requested/effective attachment, formatting-ownership conflicts, restart/logs, remote degradation.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: LSP catalog rows show provenance (built-in/catalog/custom), startup mode, requested vs effective attachment (inspector), and a formatting-ownership conflict badge when a server claims formatDocument while a Formatter also owns the language; restart + open-logs actions; remote-LSP degraded state.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Formatters: global enable, built-in/custom table, detected/not-found/disabled, command/env/ext, add/remove/reset, Global/Project scope, health+test, single-ownership-per-language conflict resolution.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Formatter table with per-language owner, detected/not-found/disabled health, command/env/ext editor, Global/Project scope switch; when two formatters claim a language, a single-ownership resolve-conflict flow picks the effective owner and demotes the other (not a silent dual-run).

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Commands & Shortcuts dedicated manager: custom command lifecycle, parameters/includes, shell-safety, dry-run preview (NEVER sends to an agent), validation, shortcut search/conflicts/remap/reset/import/export/cheat-sheet.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Dedicated Commands & Shortcuts destination: CommandEditor with parameters/includes/shell-safety gate; Dry-run button renders a preview receipt and is HARD-GATED so it can never dispatch to an agent; shortcut recorder + conflict detection + remap + reset + import/export + cheat-sheet.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Register provisional command families for C3 deep flows; reuse existing canonical IDs (lsp_restart_server, testing_capability_policy_set, catalog install/update/remove) and retire cmd.settings.bloom.open.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Command-delta register flags reuse vs alias vs new_candidate per family; no concept-only local state may masquerade as production wiring.

MCP resource rows expose transport (stdio/sse/remote-url), scope, exposed-tools-of-total, approval duration, last-contact, reconnect-on-failure with a visible result receipt, and a logs viewer; lazy-exposure loads tool detail only on expand.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Skills manager demonstrates catalog/provenance/trust, install/update/compatibility/unload, project-enablement, effective-availability, policy/risk — and HOSTS the distinct Plugins/Tools/Commands-as-kinds inside the same shared grammar.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Shared Skills manager surface lists Skills and ALSO a distinct kind axis for Plugins/Tools/Commands-as-kinds: four distinct kinds, each with its own lifecycle and info badges, but identical row grammar (ResourceList/Card/Detail). Skills carry provenance/trust/compatibility, project enablement, auto-invocation policy.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Plugins demonstrated as a DISTINCT kind inside the Skills manager (distinct lifecycle: package install, hook-timeout, tool-override) — not flattened into Skills.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Plugin kind rows surface package list, hook-timeout, tool-override (plugins may replace built-in tools), add-from-catalog vs add-local provenance, remove; lifecycle states distinct from skill enablement.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Tools carry the full 5 lifecycle states (installed / project-enabled / currently-available / selected-for-turn / actually-invoked) and are demonstrated as a DISTINCT kind inside the Skills manager.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Tool kind rows render a 5-state ladder with requested/effective inspector: a tool can be installed but not project-enabled, enabled but currently-unavailable, available but not selected-for-turn, selected but not yet invoked; effective-availability is the projection.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Testing & Debug: per-capability Auto/On/Off grid; built-in browser is PM-native Browser Program (NO Playwright terminology); simulator/emulator/device may be unavailable; DAP debugger; capture/artifacts.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Installation lifecycle (7 fixtures) and CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary; provider installation cards requested/effective.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Provider/Account/Model/Installation manager inside the expanded 'AI Brains' destination shows all 7 installation fixtures (found+ready, found+not-signed-in, multi-install shadowed, unknown-owner manual-only, explicit install, update-available-ask, update-scheduled-idle + verify-failed-rollback); OAuth boundary: CLI-owned OAuth profiles vs PM-direct OAuth vs API-key vs OpenCode-external are labeled distinctly.

plan_owner_impacts.requirement: Settings inventory must expose the C3 families under code/extensions/system categories with explicit state per row; inventory must not carry stale regular/yolo values or invalid values.
plan_owner_impacts.concept_behavior: Stack consumes the inventory category/subgroup model (code.terminal, code.editing, extensions.skills/plugins/commands, system.mcp, planning.testing); each row carries explicit Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not-configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective-differs state — never blank-as-state.

See candidate-wiring-delta.json.

slint_port_impacts.note: FLIP (first/last/invert/play) is web-DOM idiom using getBoundingClientRect. The PORTABLE contract is the semantic state: active_destination_id + expanded_set + active_subcategory. Slint must map expand to a property/layout animation (height + opacity) driven by model state, with no DOM-measurement semantic state.

Web demo may render a capped tree; production Slint tree must be virtualized/lazy (viewport-windowed nodes) with expand-capped semantics mapped from catalog.file_expand_capped. Tree state is model-owned.
Terminal transcript must be virtualized (scrollback-limit rows retained, viewport-windowed render) with font+fallback + ANSI palette + opacity; not a DOM <pre> with infinite growth.
Push/pop depth is a layout/opacity animation on expand, not a DOM reflow measurement; reduced-motion reaches the same final expanded state instantly.

Web IntersectionObserver scrollspy is replaced in Stack by a sticky subnav pill bar inside the expanded body; active pill is driven by scroll-offset/section-visibility model state, portable to Slint as a visibility/offset hook, not DOM measurement.

deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: Stack reserves an expandable destination whose body is a deferred shell; no backend state machine invented in this concept. Reaches production via shared ManagerShell + ResourceList grammar when the Server module is authored.
Reachable via shared row grammar in Stack; deep demo is concept-04. Stack demonstrates the shared tool-lifecycle grammar applies, not the container capability probes.

unresolved_questions.question: Should multiple destinations be allowed to expand simultaneously in the Stack, or strictly one-expanded-manager-at-a-time? Multi-expand improves scanability but weakens the push/pop depth metaphor.

When a formatter owns a language AND the LSP also exposes formatDocument, does the resolve flow default to the formatter unconditionally, or honor a per-project LSP-preference override? Needs Formatters_System + LSPSupport adjudication.
Should the tool selected-for-turn state persist across turns within a goal, or reset per turn? Affects the 5-state ladder projection and the receipt model.

Is cmd.settings.manager.open a single canonical verb with a destination_id param, or should each manager have its own open verb (cmd.file_manager.open, cmd.lsp.open, etc.)? Affects alias discipline vs catalog compactness.

PM-native Browser Program capability probe: does its availability feed planning.testing.cap-built-in-browser Auto resolution, and what is the exact AvailabilityReason string when the Browser Program is not installed?
